tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and box background: plain white.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Code, input boxes, the grey highlight behind a phrase, and the empty area of an image frame while it loads.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Links (underlined) and the masthead name (18.9:1 on paper).

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Almost all text: snippets, entry titles, dates, article bodies and headings (9.6:1 on paper).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: The footer and other quiet lines (4.5:1 on paper; use on paper only).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The 1px outline of every box and the 1px rules between entries inside a box.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: button and input outlines (3.5:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one red: section titles at the head of each box and article, links on hover, the primary button, the focus ring (6.5:1 on paper).

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover state of the primary button only.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (6.5:1).

families.sans: Arial, Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif

styles.name: masthead
styles.usage: The name beside the mark, Arial bold (24px on phones).

styles.name: masthead-sub
styles.sample: Architecture and Artificial Intelligence, Seoul National University

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Red title at the head of each section box and article. English only.

styles.name: entry-title
styles.usage: Entry titles in boxes and section indexes; each links to its article.

styles.name: snippet
styles.sample: 로봇이 일상 공간에 들어오면서 건축의 전제가 바뀌고 있다. I study what corridors owe to machines.
styles.usage: Snippets, dates, link lists on the board: 13px on 1.45. Hangul falls through Arial to Pretendard.

styles.name: footer
styles.sample: This site was updated on 7 November 2026

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 로봇과 사람이 같은 복도를 쓰려면 폭, 회전 반경, 시야가 함께 설계되어야 한다.
styles.usage: Article text: 15px on 1.6, about 70 characters a line in the article box.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Figure 1: Plan of the third floor at 1:200.

styles.name: footnote
styles.sample: An earlier version was presented at a seminar.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Padding inside a box, as tight as the source.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: 7px: the gap between boxes, vertically and horizontally, as in the source.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: 13px: paragraph margins, and the space above and below a rule between entries.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Around figures and tables in an article; above a heading.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Above the masthead and between it and the board.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything. No rounded corners anywhere.

tokens.name: column
tokens.usage: Inner width of a box, taken from the source (289px). Images in boxes are this wide.

tokens.name: column-outer
tokens.usage: Outer width of a box: 289px plus 2px padding and a 1px border on each side. The board's column track.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Left and right page margin.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Box outlines, table rules and every border.

tokens.name: rule-thick
tokens.usage: Top and bottom rules of tables.

tokens.name: board-4
tokens.usage: Board width with four sections across (4 x 295 + 3 x 7), from 1251px windows. Centred.

tokens.name: board-3
tokens.usage: Board width with three across, from 949px windows. Also the width of an article page (article plus one side column).

tokens.name: board-2
tokens.usage: Board width with two across, from 647px windows. Also the outer width of an article box.

tokens.name: frame-wide
tokens.usage: The widest an image frame gets. A wider image is shown in a 2:1 frame, cropped at its sides around its focus point.

tokens.name: frame-tall
tokens.usage: The tallest an image frame gets. A taller image is shown in a 4:5 frame, cropped at top and bottom around its focus point. Between the two limits an image is shown whole, at its own proportions.
